prompt: Write a one-star review of the Eiffel Tower from an American who has seen the one in Las Vegas.
response:
**★☆☆☆☆ Huge disappointment. Stick to the one in Vegas.**

Honestly, save your airfare. I don’t understand why everyone hypes this place up so much when the one in Nevada is infinitely better. 

First of all, the convenience factor here is zero. In Vegas, I can ride the elevator up, look at the beautiful Bellagio fountains across the Strip, and be back downstairs playing blackjack and drinking a yard-long frozen margarita in fifteen minutes. Here? Good luck. You have to stand in line outside in the dirt for hours, and there isn't a single Fat Tuesday or slot machine at the base. What are you even supposed to do while you wait?

Also, I'm pretty sure this one hasn't been updated in decades. It looks super rusty up close, whereas the Paris Las Vegas one is incredibly clean and well-maintained. 

When we finally got inside, we tried to ask a security guard where the Gordon Ramsay Steakhouse was, and he just looked at me like I was crazy and wouldn't even speak English to me. The customer service in this country is atrocious. 

And the view? Instead of a gorgeous neon skyline and luxury resorts, you just look out over a bunch of old, gray buildings. 

Save yourself the 10-hour flight. The US did it better. Definitely do not recommend.
